verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a runtime probe noting that jo's llms.txt documents "ZDR model routing". Zero-data-retention routing implies model providers do not keep, and so cannot train on, user data, but the pack never states a no-training policy or describes how it works. Per-user isolated machines are a related privacy feature, not a training control, and earn no credit. Missing for 10: explicit first-party statement that user data is not used for model training, documented details of ZDR scope and covered providers, any user-facing opt-out or control, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
